tools.name: bluefolder_list_customers
tools.description: List customers (basic: id, name, type, inactive flag; full: more fields). BlueFolder API: POST /customers/list.aspx.

tools.name: bluefolder_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer with its contacts and locations. Give customerId or externalId. BlueFolder API: POST /customers/get.aspx.

tools.name: bluefolder_list_service_requests
tools.description: List service requests (jobs), optionally filtered by customer, status, billing status, invoice or reference number, or a created/closed date range. Use status 'open' for all non-closed requests. BlueFolder API: POST /serviceRequests/list.aspx.

tools.name: bluefolder_get_service_request
tools.description: Get one service request with its items, labor, materials, expenses, assignments and billing totals. Give serviceRequestId or externalId. BlueFolder API: POST /serviceRequests/get.aspx.

tools.name: bluefolder_get_service_request_history
tools.description: Get the history and comments of one service request. Give serviceRequestId or externalId. BlueFolder API: POST /serviceRequests/getHistory.aspx.

tools.name: bluefolder_list_equipment
tools.description: List equipment (assets), optionally for one customer by customerId or customerExternalId. BlueFolder API: POST /equipment/list.aspx.

tools.name: bluefolder_get_equipment
tools.description: Get one equipment item with its service dates and notes. BlueFolder API: POST /equipment/get.aspx.

tools.name: bluefolder_list_contracts
tools.description: List service contracts, optionally filtered by customer or status. BlueFolder API: POST /contracts/list.aspx.

tools.name: bluefolder_get_contract
tools.description: Get one contract with its balances, billing details and limits. BlueFolder API: POST /contracts/get.aspx.

tools.name: bluefolder_list_items
tools.description: List catalog items (parts, labor and service items) with unit price and cost. BlueFolder API: POST /items/list.aspx.

tools.name: bluefolder_get_item
tools.description: Get one catalog item with its unit price, cost and manufacturer data. BlueFolder API: POST /items/get.aspx.

tools.name: bluefolder_list_users
tools.description: List the BlueFolder users (technicians, dispatchers, admins) with their ids and types. BlueFolder API: POST /users/list.aspx.

tools.name: bluefolder_get_user
tools.description: Get one BlueFolder user (no password). BlueFolder API: POST /users/get.aspx.

tools.name: bluefolder_list_tax_codes
tools.description: List the tax codes and rates set up in the account. BlueFolder API: POST /taxCodes/list.aspx.

tools.name: bluefolder_add_service_request
tools.description: Create a new service request (job) for a customer. It sends no customer email unless notifyCustomer is true. BlueFolder API: POST /serviceRequests/add.aspx.

tools.name: bluefolder_add_service_request_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a service request. A public comment with notifyCustomer true emails the customer. BlueFolder API: POST /serviceRequests/addComment.aspx.

tools.name: bluefolder_add_customer_comment
tools.description: Add an internal comment to a customer record. BlueFolder API: POST /customers/addComment.aspx.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "bluefolder_get_user" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Get one BlueFolder user (no password). BlueFolder API: POST /users/get.aspx.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bluefolder_list_customers, bluefolder_get_customer, bluefolder_list_service_requests, bluefolder_get_service_request, bluefolder_get_service_request_history, bluefolder_list_equipment, bluefolder_get_equipment, bluefolder_list_contracts, bluefolder_get_contract, bluefolder_list_items, bluefolder_get_item, bluefolder_list_users, bluefolder_get_user, bluefolder_list_tax_codes · Private data: bluefolder_get_customer, bluefolder_get_user, bluefolder_add_customer_comment · Public sink: bluefolder_list_customers, bluefolder_get_customer, bluefolder_list_service_requests, bluefolder_get_service_request, bluefolder_get_service_request_history, bluefolder_list_equipment, bluefolder_get_equipment, bluefolder_list_contracts, bluefolder_get_contract, bluefolder_list_items, bluefolder_get_item, bluefolder_list_users, bluefolder_get_user, bluefolder_list_tax_codes, bluefolder_add_service_request, bluefolder_add_service_request_comment, bluefolder_add_customer_comment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bluefolder_list_customers, bluefolder_get_customer, bluefolder_list_service_requests, bluefolder_get_service_request, bluefolder_get_service_request_history, bluefolder_list_equipment, bluefolder_get_equipment, bluefolder_list_contracts, bluefolder_get_contract, bluefolder_list_items, bluefolder_get_item, bluefolder_list_users, bluefolder_get_user, bluefolder_list_tax_codes · Private data: bluefolder_get_customer, bluefolder_get_user, bluefolder_add_customer_comment · Public sink: bluefolder_list_customers, bluefolder_get_customer, bluefolder_list_service_requests, bluefolder_get_service_request, bluefolder_get_service_request_history, bluefolder_list_equipment, bluefolder_get_equipment, bluefolder_list_contracts, bluefolder_get_contract, bluefolder_list_items, bluefolder_get_item, bluefolder_list_users, bluefolder_get_user, bluefolder_list_tax_codes, bluefolder_add_service_request, bluefolder_add_service_request_comment, bluefolder_add_customer_comment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
